name: nodetocode
description: Read, translate and migrate Unreal Engine Blueprints from Claude Code: NodeToCode's MCP server (the open editor's Blueprints as N2C JSON, translation, graph editing), three Agent Skills, a /nodetocode:translate command and a session-start check that says how to reach the editor.

mcp_url.title: NodeToCode MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The editor's NodeToCode MCP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:<Server Port>/mcp (Project Settings > Plugins > Node to Code > MCP Server). Change it only when the server uses another port.
